faq.q: What have houses in Mission sold for?

items.t: 252 houses sold in Mission at a median of $891,000 (middle half $784,975 to $1,075,000). A typical house in Mission spent 33 days on the market and closed at 97.1% of the asking price.
In Mission, townhomes sold at a median of $679,000 across 55 sales, and the middle half closed between $630,000 and $709,900. The median townhome sat 30 days and sold for 98.6% of list.
Mission: 33 condos sold at a median of $470,000, with the middle half between $405,999 and $525,000. The median condo took 33 days to sell and closed at 97.6% of list.
16 duplexes sold in Mission at a median of $935,595 (middle half $627,500 to $1,021,250). A typical duplex in Mission spent 19 days on the market and closed at 98.0% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.

items.t: Houses in Mission have the second lowest median of 4 Mission sub-areas, $891,000. Lake Errock is lowest at $865,000 and Mission-West highest at $1,725,000. Lake Errock ($865,000) sits just below and Hatzic ($985,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, duplexes are the newest homes selling in Mission (median 2025) and houses the oldest (median 1991), a gap of 34 years.
